findings.desc: concept-cleanup: tier-c-crosshost-quorum-threat-model.md still attributes pinned-key enforcement to M1 (4 residual references at lines 6, 39, 44, 71) after this story redefined M1 to crypto-deferred cross-host review and moved pinned-key work to M-crypto; the phrase "this is the core M1 fix" at line 44 now points at the wrong milestone
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in ca7615450 (see commit body); smoke 21 checks green, tsc clean.

findings.desc: concept-cleanup: cross_host_review command calls submitLocalVerdict twice and emits host_verdict process events (L4 evidence-producing), but is missing entries in both command-policy.ts and process-fact-levels.ts — every other evidence-producing command (autopilot_review_submit, quorum_submit) has both entries; without a command-policy entry the access-control tier is undeclared
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in ca7615450 (see commit body); smoke 21 checks green, tsc clean.

findings.desc: dispatch-policy: allowReviewOnlyRealHostSubprocess=true un-gates checkDispatchPolicy for codex but lattice-dispatch.ts line 2710 triggers runCodexRealLeafDispatch on allowRealHostSubprocess===true alone — a policy with both flags + allowedHosts=[codex] passes checkDispatchPolicy as authorized, then lattice-dispatch runs the IMPLEMENTATION path; the review-only narrowing is enforced only at the policy-check layer, not at the dispatch-execution layer, defeating the stated narrower-grant intent
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in ca7615450 (see commit body); smoke 21 checks green, tsc clean.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: handlers/cross-host-review.ts CrossHostReviewArgs.policy (line 26) and command-catalog description promise "Optional dispatch policy name governing the read-only Codex subprocess" but args.policy is never read or applied in the handler — the Codex subprocess runs unconditionally with no policy enforcement; the envDenylist, allowedPaths, maxRuntimeMinutes, and commandAllowlist from any supplied policy are silently ignored
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in ca7615450 (see commit body); smoke 21 checks green, tsc clean.

findings.desc: handlers/cross-host-review.ts line 287: jointDecision is called without the optional JointMaterialBinding parameter, leaving the materialHash-divergence guard in core/cross-host-review.ts unused in production; the leaf already fails closed on mismatch so this is defense-in-depth only, but the handler never passes hostAMaterialHash+hostBMaterialHash even though both are available (materialDigest and hostBVerdict.materialHash), and the feature is smoke-tested only at the direct pure-function level (CHK-002:adversarial:0), not through the handler
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in ca7615450 (see commit body); smoke 21 checks green, tsc clean.

findings.desc: dead-code: dispatch-policy.ts:447-448 reviewOnlyCodex is always false inside checkDispatchPolicy — the variable is computed as `allowReviewOnlyRealHostSubprocess===true && allowRealHostSubprocess!==true` but the entire enclosing block is `if (policyRecord.allowRealHostSubprocess===true)`, making the second operand permanently false. The variable is never true, so its only use at L451 (`!reviewOnlyCodex`) never fires. The surrounding comment correctly states codex must stay refused here regardless, so the behavior is intentional — but the dead variable misleads readers into thinking a review-only exemption exists within this branch. The dead variable should be removed and the filter simplified to `if (host===antigravity || host===gemini || host===codex) return true` (with a one-line comment referencing the mutual-exclusion invariant).
findings.resolvedReason: Removed dead reviewOnlyCodex var in checkDispatchPolicy; codex refused directly in the allowRealHostSubprocess block, carve-out lives in create/validate path (ecbce6853)

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: handlers/cross-host-review.ts:48 buildRedactedEnv empty-allowlist semantics undocumented and unsafe-by-default — when policy.envAllowlist is [] (the default from createDispatchPolicy and normalizeDispatchPolicyRecord), `allowlist.size>0` is false and the allowlist guard is completely bypassed, so every env var not matching UNSAFE_ENV_PATTERN passes through to the codex subprocess (e.g. DATABASE_URL, OPENAI_ORG_ID, GH_HOST, any non-standard secret names). The function comment says `ONLY those names may pass` but qualifies it with `If the policy declares an envAllowlist`, making the empty-allowlist=allow-all behavior a silent footgun. The fix is to document this explicitly in the function comment (e.g. `empty allowlist = allow-all minus denylist/pattern — this is intentional but callers should set an explicit allowlist for production use`) and ideally emit a warning or treat empty allowlist as deny-all for the review subprocess path, which is the higher-security default.
findings.resolvedReason: Broadened UNSAFE_ENV_PATTERN to catch DATABASE/DSN/CONNECTION/AUTH/SESSION/COOKIE/PRIVATE/ACCESS/*_URL/*_URI + documented empty-allowlist semantics (ecbce6853)

findings.desc: CHK-001:adversarial:2 through :5 are implemented as runtime smoke checks but are NOT registered as verificationIntents in the checklist and have no verificationEvidence. The smoke grew 17->21 but the checklist verificationIntent list still only declares 17 intents. The four new checks exercise real F-003/F-004 fix behaviors (codex BOTH-flags refused; missing policy fail-closed; unauthorized policy fail-closed; env-denylist+timeout threaded to runner) — each is non-hollow and non-tautological. They must be registered as verificationIntents (priority=must, category=adversarial) so the gate can verify the new fix behaviors are evidenced.

All 17 verificationEvidence records are stale: their materialHash binds to headHash e89b0aa54916b1cb8b26c84b84a0c27deb8dd304 (pre-fix baseline), but commit ca7615450 advanced the material hash. The validate gate reports 0/17 covered. The evidence records are non-hollow (they name specific smoke check labels, exact command, and specific assertions) but they must be re-stamped against the current materialHash after the fix commit for the REVIEW gate to consider them fresh.
findings.resolvedReason: Refreshed 21/21 verification evidence to current materialHash (6af70a7)

findings.desc: handlers/cross-host-review.ts lines 476-548 computes the HEAD materialDigest and performs assertMaterialCleanForReview only before spawning Codex, then records verdicts after runCodexReviewLeaf without isolating the tree or rechecking/locking material state. Because codex exec reviews the live mutable worktree and the leaf verdict merely echoes the requested materialHash, another local writer can modify source after the clean preflight but before or during the review; the recorded pass/fail is then bound to HEAD even though Codex reviewed transient uncommitted content. CHK-001:adversarial:6 only covers dirt present before spawn, not this TOCTOU window. Run Codex against an immutable clean snapshot/temp worktree at HEAD, or hold a source write lease and revalidate material state before recording.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 99f6d050e: cross_host_review now creates a detached clean HEAD snapshot for Codex, runs the review against that snapshot, then re-checks the original story worktree before recording. Smoke CHK-001:adversarial:6 proves dirty preflight fails before spawn, post-spawn source drift fails before record, no verdict is recorded, and .lattice-only metadata drift still proceeds. Full lattice validate PASS recorded in cade28cf8.

findings.desc: cross_host_review accepts caller-supplied hostA/hostB identifiers but never fail-closed-validates that host A and host B remain independent. If a caller passes the same host id, the handler derives the same sessionId/keyId for both records and can still return jointDecision=pass when both decisions pass and findings agree. Downstream summarizeVerdicts collapses the shared identity, but the new cross_host_review proof surface itself can overstate an independent joint pass instead of stopping on non-independent reviewer identities. Mirror quorum_submit's hostId/sessionId/keyId independence guard before recording verdicts or computing jointDecision.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 99f6d050e: cross_host_review now derives hostA/hostB identities before Codex spawn and rejects shared hostId/sessionId/keyId, so a caller cannot manufacture an independent joint pass from one host. Smoke CHK-002:adversarial:2 proves identical hostA/hostB identity is rejected before spawn and records no verdict. Full lattice validate PASS recorded in cade28cf8.

findings.desc: F-010 still has a committed-HEAD drift window: cross_host_review computes materialDigest/storyFilesHash/headHash from HEAD at handlers/cross-host-review.ts:536-544, then creates the review snapshot with the moving ref HEAD at :622 and, after Codex returns, only checks git status cleanliness at :639. A concurrent local writer can make a clean commit after the hash capture: if it lands before snapshot creation Codex reviews the new HEAD while the verdict binds the old materialDigest; if it lands after snapshot creation the handler records an old-HEAD verdict while the story worktree current HEAD has moved. In both cases git status is clean, so the post-spawn dirty-worktree check passes. The fix covers uncommitted material drift but not committed HEAD/material drift. Pin the snapshot to the captured headHash and fail closed before submitLocalVerdict unless currentGitHead/currentMaterialHash/currentStoryFilesHash still match the captured values; add smoke coverage for clean committed drift.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 0c27d45e6: cross_host_review now captures current HEAD, creates the Codex review snapshot at that exact captured SHA instead of moving HEAD, checks HEAD has not changed before spawn, and re-checks HEAD identity before recording. Smoke CHK-001:adversarial:6 now proves a clean concurrent commit moves HEAD while source is clean, Codex still reviews the captured-HEAD snapshot, and the handler fails closed with cross_host_review_head_drift without recording a verdict. Full lattice validate PASS recorded in 08a1e3178.

findings.desc: Quality review confirms the same committed-HEAD drift window as B-f57a:F-012: F-010 is not fully closed because cross_host_review captures materialDigest/storyFilesHash/headHash from HEAD at packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:536-544, but createCleanHeadReviewWorktree later runs git worktree add --detach <tmp> HEAD at packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:314-323. HEAD is not pinned to the captured headHash, so a clean concurrent commit/reset/rebase between those points can make the detached snapshot review a different tree than the recorded materialDigest. The post-run check at packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:639 only checks dirty status relative to the then-current HEAD, so it passes after a clean HEAD advance, and verdicts are recorded at packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:651-679 with stale bindings. The smoke coverage at packages/main/src/tasks/cross-host-review-smoke.ts:1139-1191 covers uncommitted source drift but not clean HEAD advancement. Pin the snapshot to the captured headHash and fail closed before submitLocalVerdict unless currentGitHead/currentMaterialHash/currentStoryFilesHash still match the captured values; add a smoke case for clean committed drift.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 0c27d45e6: createCleanHeadReviewWorktree now checks out the captured headHash, not the moving HEAD ref, and cross_host_review revalidates currentGitHead(projectRoot) still equals that captured hash before recording. Smoke CHK-001:adversarial:6 proves clean post-spawn HEAD advancement is rejected with cross_host_review_head_drift and records no verdict. Full lattice validate PASS recorded in 08a1e3178.

findings.desc: cross_host_review still hashes the moving HEAD before capturing the HEAD SHA: packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:545-553 computes materialDigest and storyFilesHash with ref "HEAD" before currentGitHead captures headHash. A clean concurrent commit between those separate git commands yields old materialDigest/storyFilesHash but new headHash; assertReviewHeadStillCurrent then treats the new HEAD as expected, createCleanHeadReviewWorktree snapshots that new SHA, and the post-spawn HEAD check can pass, so submitLocalVerdict records a verdict whose material binding does not match the reviewed snapshot. Bind in the opposite order: capture headHash first, compute currentMaterialHash/currentStoryFilesHash against that exact SHA (or recompare current HEAD/material/story hashes to the captured tuple before spawn and before record), and add smoke coverage for a clean commit between material-hash capture and headHash capture.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 96fcfb0a3: cross_host_review now captures headHash before material/story hash computation, then computes currentMaterialHash/currentStoryFilesHash against that captured SHA rather than moving HEAD. It rechecks live HEAD before spawn/record. Smoke CHK-001:adversarial:6 proves a clean commit after captured HEAD but before hash binding fails closed with cross_host_review_head_drift before Codex spawn, records no verdict, and full validate PASS is recorded in ff308c1b7.

findings.desc: cross_host_review still has a pre-capture HEAD race: packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts computes materialDigest and storyFilesHash from the moving ref HEAD before capturing headHash. A clean concurrent commit between those git commands can produce an old materialDigest/storyFilesHash paired with a new headHash; the new pre/post head guards then accept the new headHash, createCleanHeadReviewWorktree snapshots the new commit, and submitLocalVerdict can record a verdict whose material binding does not match the reviewed snapshot. Capture headHash first and compute currentMaterialHash/currentStoryFilesHash against that exact SHA, or re-check the full head/material/story tuple before spawn and before record. Add smoke coverage for a clean commit between material-hash capture and headHash capture.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 96fcfb0a3: the handler no longer pairs old material/storyFiles hashes with a later headHash because headHash is captured first and all hashes are computed against that exact SHA. The pre-hash clean-commit smoke in CHK-001:adversarial:6 proves Codex is never spawned and no verdict is recorded when live HEAD moves before hash binding completes. Full validate PASS recorded in ff308c1b7.
